messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: incident fired: prometheus_scrape_failures_prod (severity: high). Affected targets: 14 exporters missing for >2m. PD link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345
pagerduty-bot: Alert escalated to on-call: raj (oncall)
raj (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking. any obvious customer impact yet?
maria (sre): noticed dashboards missing a bunch of metrics for services: service.api.requests_total, service.db.latency. Customers might see stale charts. no direct errors reported from product pages yet.
olivia (prod): we got a customer message saying their dashboard shows zeros for request rate for a few minutes, not sure if they have alerts.
raj (oncall): ok step 1: check prometheus targets and exporter pods. pulling prometheus targets now.
maria (sre): results from /targets: most blackbox exporters for node-exporter and app-exporters in eu-west-1 show "context deadline exceeded" or "dial tcp timeout". 14/120 targets down, same IP range.
kevin (eng-runtime): could be network flapping to that AZ or an autoscaler evicting the exporters. any recent deploys to prometheus scrape-proxy?
raj (oncall): no deploys in the window per deploy-bot, timestamp matches 5:12 UTC.
maria (sre): checking kube events in eu-west-1 namespace metrics-exporters: saw several evictions due to kubelet OOM at ~5:10. Kubelet logs show memory pressure, then many exporters restarted.
olivia (prod): could explain the blackout — if exporters restarted and prometheus scrapes timed out while backoff happened. customers might see a gap of ~2-5m.
raj (oncall): runbook step: restart stuck exporters and scale up replicas to avoid thundering restart. pulling list of affected deployments.
maria (sre): here are quick commands I'm running:```bash
kubectl -n metrics get pods -o wide | grep exporter | grep CrashLoop
kubectl -n metrics rollout restart deploy/app-exporter --timeout=2m
kubectl -n metrics scale deploy/app-exporter --replicas=4
```
raj (oncall): doing a controlled rollout restart on the most impacted exporter, increasing CPU/memory requests temporarily.
kevin (eng-runtime): also double-check kafka-ingest backlog — if exporters were down, logs might queue and cause log-ingest lag. monitoring kafka consumer lag now.
maria (sre): kafka lag for metrics-log topic shows a small spike but consumers recovered. log-ingest backlog under control. Prometheus scrape backlog is the main issue.
raj (oncall): started a short-term mitigation: bumped exporter replicas from 2->4 and increased memory limit for node-exporter to 300Mi. watching.
maria (sre): metrics target status changing: some targets are coming back, progressive green.
olivia (prod): customer reports dashboards showing metrics returning. :slightly_smiling_face:
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by raj (oncall) at 2026-03-15T05:18:20Z
raj (oncall): assigning to eng-runtime for root cause & long-term fix. kevin, can you take this?
kevin (eng-runtime): on it. initial hypothesis: kubelet memory pressure caused mass restarts in the metrics namespace due to a noisy process elsewhere. I'll check node metrics + eviction root cause and open a follow-up.
maria (sre): will open a short timeline and customer-impact note in the incident doc.
raj (oncall): handoff: I'm paged out, handing to kevin for postmortem. Interim actions we took: scaled exporters, increased mem limits, restarted crashed pods, verified prometheus scrape success, monitored kafka lag.
kevin (eng-runtime): thanks. immediate next steps: (1) audit recent jobs on nodes in that AZ, (2) add node-level memory alarms to catch recurrence, (3) update exporter pod spec to include oomScoreAdj and guaranteed QoS if possible.
maria (sre): adding checklist to incident doc and creating runbook link: https://docs.redwood.com/runbooks/metrics-scrape-outage (draft)
raj (oncall): closing PD incident once kevin confirms postmortem created and customer communication queued. anyone need me to stay?
olivia (prod): I'll send a short note to the affected customer: "We observed a brief metrics ingestion disruption affecting dashboards between 05:10-05:17 UTC. Exporter restarts caused temporary scrape failures; metrics are backfilled and dashboards should reflect correct data. We'll follow up with a postmortem."
kevin (eng-runtime): confirmed. creating PM ticket and root-cause doc. proposed long-term fixes: raise exporter resource requests, add graceful restart probe, update scraping timeout to 10s for flaky targets, and add a k8s node OOM alert to SRE runbook.
maria (sre): follow-up action: add a canary scrape job to detect partial AZ outages earlier.
raj (oncall): marking last_message_ts now. good job team. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved: prometheus_scrape_failures_prod (PD12345) — status: resolved.
